## Known limitations of this import

- Upstream's SKILL.md description is 1,619 characters, above SK006's 1,024 limit, so the upstream skill is a read-only reference. The routable skill is authored here.
- As of the pinned commit, upstream ships no standalone LICENSE file. README.md declares MIT; copyright is not stated. The declaration is preserved verbatim in LICENSE.upstream as evidence, not as a standalone licence. The manifest check records the declaration; it does not verify the right to license.
- data/ is runtime state and is deliberately not vendored. file_include is the enforcing filter; the exclude entry is a literal name used by the validate_manifest check.
- The prompt set is research guidance, not verified market data. Outputs still need citation checks.

## Notes

Mapped as a read-only support tree under docs/reference-sources, mirroring the Addy Osmani SDD reference. The relative layout inside source/ is preserved so the upstream SKILL.md links keep resolving. file_include, not exclude, is what actually keeps data/ out. Support exclude entries are literal names, not globs.
